ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo Library access is required to set your profile image. Images you select from your library can be used as your profile photo.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location access is required to check your current location and the locations of partner restaurants on the map. For example, it is used to show your location on the map.

ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Location access is required to check your current location and the locations of partner restaurants on the map. For example, it is used to show your location on the map.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is required to recognize leftover food. It is used to take a photo of the remaining food after a meal and check the amount of leftovers.
